high_level_description: The image is a news article headline accompanied by a collage of various clothing items. The text at the top reads: "French luxury company Hermes on Tuesday announced that a British designer, Grace Wales Bonner, is taking over its men's pret-a-porter collection from a predecessor who held the position for nearly four decades." Below this text, there is a collage of different clothing items, including jackets, shirts, pants, gloves, boots, and coveralls.
